changes_vs_current: Top 3 now Christmas, Thanksgiving, Halloween then Easter and Mother's Day; Fourth of July falls 4 to 10 and Valentine's 7 to 12 (poll-based 'like/favorite' measures favor civic and family holidays: Veterans Day 21 to 8, Memorial Day 12 to 9, MLK 22 to 11, Father's Day 14 to 7). Ranks 16-24 have no data and keep the old order (Super Bowl Sunday only has a YouGov 2024 'least favorite' 13% signal).
confidence: medium for ranks 1-15, none for 16-24. 3 real sources, but two are the same YouGov family and mix 'favorite' with 'like' measures; Fourth of July is penalized by being omitted from the 2022 15-item table (participation data like Prosper Insights puts it #2 but that page was not fetched). Statista Q3 2025 YouGov ratings (Thanksgiving, Veterans Day, Memorial Day top) confirmed the same pattern but figures were paywalled so not used.
